notes.tariff_optionality: Supreme Court struck down 2025 IEEPA tariffs. ROST filed CBP refund claims but recognised no receivable/gain as of 2026-05-02 and excluded refunds from forward guidance. TJX booked its equivalent in Q2 (~$0.14/share, GAAP $1.36 vs adj $1.22). A one-time ROST refund gain could distort headline GAAP EPS versus the $1.92 consensus.
